label: Lithium-ion
definition: Rechargeable lithium-ion cells and batteries (UN 3480 alone, UN 3481 in or with equipment); watt-hour rating required for transport

label: Lithium Polymer
definition: Rechargeable lithium-ion polymer cells; transport as lithium-ion (UN 3480/3481)

label: Lithium Iron Phosphate
definition: Rechargeable lithium-ion chemistry used in power stations and e-mobility; transport as lithium-ion

label: Lithium Metal
definition: Non-rechargeable lithium metal cells including coin cells (UN 3090 alone, UN 3091 in or with equipment); lithium content required for transport

label: Nickel-Metal Hydride
definition: Rechargeable NiMH cells (UN 3496 for sea transport rules)

label: Nickel-Cadmium
definition: Rechargeable NiCd cells; cadmium content restricted in several markets

label: Alkaline
definition: Non-rechargeable alkaline cells (AA, AAA, C, D, 9V and button formats)

label: Silver Oxide
definition: Non-rechargeable silver oxide button cells (watches, hearing aids)

label: Lead-Acid
definition: Rechargeable lead-acid batteries including sealed, AGM and gel (UN 2794/2795/2800 as applicable)

label: Sodium-ion
definition: Rechargeable sodium-ion cells (UN 3551 alone, UN 3552 in or with equipment, from the 2025 regulations)
